references.role: owner-approved identity, face, proportions, costume, and equipment reference
initial style descriptor for CPS2-Alpha-Cel; not independently validated

revision_notes: Candidate generated from the approved Dr. Social concept reference, then laid out with a readable relative ruler and style metadata.
Front, profile, and back views are presented at a shared scale and baseline; owner should confirm their exact alignment and the character invariants.
All art-review axes remain pending; this record does not self-approve the producer's work.

document_and_layout.note: Owner to confirm the five requested views and clear model-sheet layout.

style_reference_application.note: Owner to assess the CPS2-Alpha-Cel direction and its adaptation to the game's shared art language.

lineart_and_contours.note: Owner to inspect line weight, contour consistency, and edge cleanliness.

morphology_and_biotype.note: Owner to confirm the lean, long-limbed ectomorph morphology and proportions across views.

shading_and_palette.note: Owner to check three-tone cel shading and the established Dr. Social palette roles.

relative_scale_and_baseline.note: Owner to confirm H definition, approximately 7.5H target, orthographic scale, and shared baseline.

neutral_background.note: Owner to confirm the clean pale background supports silhouette inspection without distraction.

face_and_identity_continuity.note: Owner to compare face, gray hair, spectacles, age, expression, and identity with the approved concept.

costume_and_materials.note: Owner to check coat, shirt, cravat, boots, colors, and material treatment against the approved design.

equipment_and_weapon_continuity.note: Owner to trace cane, rapier, and occult steel boomerang shape, grip, and attachment across views.

cross_view_consistency.note: Owner to verify that front, profile, back, face close-up, and signature pose depict one consistent design.

legibility_and_crop_integrity.note: Owner to inspect labels, ruler, details, and whether any body part or equipment is clipped.

human_traits_and_unapproved_details.note: Owner to confirm Dr. Social remains fully human and has no unsupported symbols, costume details, or powers.

claim_ceiling: concept_model_sheet_candidate_only; no sprite, animation, resource, ROM, or emulator approval
